data.gender_notes: Carima is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'karimah' which means 'noble, generous, and precious'. The name Carima adds the meaning of 'fragrant, sweet, and fertile'. The name Carima carries the meaning “Fragrant, sweet, fertile” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Carima usually hope their child will grow to embody fragrant, sweet, fertile and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Carima is a reminder of the sweetness and fragrance of life, and the generosity and nobility that comes from within.
data.etymology: Carima belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fragrant, sweet, fertile.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Carima total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
